name: CaseGridAreaEmptySlot
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-area-empty-slot" (grid-areas). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a declared grid area with NO children (empty slot)
